title: Visual Audio & Geometry OS: Spatial Computing, Bootable Pixel Substrates, and the Glyph Architecture
description: Geometry OS and the Visual Audio system represent a paradigm shift from symbolic to spatial computing. It implements 'The Screen is the Hard Drive' and 'The Screen is the Mind' through Hilbert-curve packed 2D pixel containers (VAC2/PXC1/.rts.png) bootable directly via hypervisor block backends (virtio_pixel_backend), executed by a dual-substrate spatial ISA (Glyph ISA v2 with lockstep CPU and WGSL GPU twins), and self-hosted through machine-proven in-image tile admission.
